newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy offers mostly steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy offers mostly steady to lower.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers were mostly steady to lower on Friday while corn and wheat values were flat, dealers said.
Some movement in corn and soybeans was noted from parts of the U.S. Midwest, dealers said.
A U.S. soybean exporter said one factor behind the soybean declines was the continued August/November spread activity on the Chicago Board of Trade.
On the export front, Morocco was seeking a total of 120,000 tonnes of optional-origin wheat to be delivered in August and September, European traders said.
